## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S2. This is audit backlog UX-12 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Every signed-in page on Azure dev · owner doctor and receptionist · 768 and 375.
Findings and reviewers: F-13, F-46, and the check asked by F-38 · reviewer A-27, lead arbiter.
Rationale: What is deployed is behind what is built: on Azure dev the header scrolls sideways at 768 and 375 px (page width 939 and 511 px) and hides Sign out; main does not. The pilot runs on this environment, and the validation sessions use it. Its patients named Test Patient 2 lack the (synthetic) marker the house rule asks for.
Proposed UX behaviour: Tag and deploy current main to Azure dev by the usual workflow. Run the audit's Azure capture again at 768 and 375 px for the owner doctor and the receptionist. Rename or reseed the Azure synthetic patients so each carries (synthetic). While there, check on Azure whether Settings → Terms says booking is paused while booking works, and record the answer on the small-fixes ticket.
Prototype and blueprint reference: None.
Components and tokens affected: None.
Front end and back end split: Deploy and data only. No code.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None. Do it in the first days: the pilot doctor's sessions run on the redeployed app.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low. Real Entra sign-in may behave differently from the development provider (the step-up return was only seen locally): note anything seen.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Staging or production. (2) Any infrastructure change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given Azure dev after the deploy, when every captured page is measured at 768 and 375 px, then page width equals viewport width
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the same widths, when the header is used, then Sign out can be reached
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the deployed version, when it is compared with main, then it is the tagged commit and main was green
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the Azure dev patients, when Today and the board are opened, then every patient name carries (synthetic)
- [ ] **AC5.** Given Settings → Terms on Azure, when booking is tried, then the result (status line right or wrong) is written on the small-fixes ticket
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the capture output, when it is stored, then it holds synthetic data only and no credential; the founder signs in by hand

## Test notes

- The audit capture script at 768 and 375 against Azure dev; widths recorded in the issue.
- No new Playwright spec.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
- Needs a person: the founder signs in with MFA for the capture.
